title: Working on Paste: Liquid Glass design and Paste MCP
description: I am part of the Paste team. I contributed the iOS 26 Liquid Glass design to Paste 6, and Paste now brings clipboard history into AI tools.
body:
I am part of the Paste team. Here are two things the team shipped.

## Paste 6 in Liquid Glass

In September 2025 Paste 6 launched on Product Hunt as "Your Clipboard Reimagined in Liquid Glass". My contribution was the iOS 26 Liquid Glass design.

In Paste's own words, the new design is fluid at every touch and beautifully transparent. It feels native to the 26 family: iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and macOS 26.

The launch page is on [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/products/paste/launches/paste-6).

## Paste MCP

In June 2026 Paste announced Paste MCP. It brings clipboard history, context and pinboards directly into AI tools like Claude, Codex and Cursor.

From Paste's announcement: find what you copied, use saved context, and create pinboards without leaving the tool you are in.

Paste MCP is the team's work, and I am glad to be part of it. Details are on [pasteapp.io/mcp](https://pasteapp.io/mcp).

*Originally posted on LinkedIn: [Paste 6 in Liquid Glass](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/romanres_paste-6-your-clipboard-reimagined-in-liquid-activity-7374359437563609088-5Abf) and [Paste MCP](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/romanres_mcp-ai-tools-paste-activity-7467484182135328768-qqhE).*
